stakeholders.role: A local UAV/counter-UAS integrator and radar distributor that could be a partner or a competing channel.
stakeholders.recommended_next_step: Lead with RF detection or datalink integration and request an explicit conflict-of-interest check against its exclusive radar agency.
stakeholders.name: JC Tech

stakeholders.recent_fact: March 23, 2026 reporting described Cub’s Taiwan-made Aegis counter-drone system, developed with international partners and combining RF processing, AI image analysis and high-frequency radar.
stakeholders.stance_signal: Competitive on integrated counter-UAS capability, but its international co-development demonstrates openness to external technology; willingness to add another supplier is unconfirmed.
stakeholders.key_person: Yu Shan-chuan (尤山泉) — Founder, quoted in March 2026 reporting
stakeholders.name_local: 為升電裝工業股份有限公司
stakeholders.role: A Taiwanese manufacturer and integrated counter-UAS competitor with radar, RF and image-analysis capabilities.
stakeholders.recommended_next_step: Ask whether it has an unmet sensor or datalink requirement suitable for a non-exclusive component evaluation rather than offering to replace its entire system.
stakeholders.name: Cub Elecparts Inc.

stakeholders.recent_fact: On September 15, 2025, AIDC announced a teaming agreement with Shield AI covering an advanced unmanned-systems ecosystem, including manufacturing, assembly, testing, maintenance and training.
stakeholders.stance_signal: Supportive of US–Taiwan technical cooperation, evidenced by the agreement; this is adjacent unmanned-systems experience, not proof of a counter-UAS procurement mandate.
stakeholders.name_local: 漢翔航空工業股份有限公司
stakeholders.role: A local aerospace prime with manufacturing, integration and sustainment capabilities relevant to a Taiwan-led sensor offering.
stakeholders.recommended_next_step: Present a limited local-integration and sustainment work package and ask whether AIDC would sponsor or subcontract a counter-UAS sensor demonstration.
stakeholders.name: Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation

stakeholders.recent_fact: On October 14, 2026, Thunder Tiger and AeroVironment announced an MOU to explore unmanned-systems integration, localization, co-production and future capability development in Taiwan.
stakeholders.stance_signal: Supportive of US technology partnerships, inferred from the MOU; no specific interest in this counter-UAS sensor kit is documented.
stakeholders.role: A Taiwanese unmanned-systems OEM and potential local manufacturing or field-support partner.
stakeholders.recommended_next_step: Request a feasibility discussion focused on local sensor-kit assembly and government-demonstration support, with clear ownership of sales and support responsibilities.
stakeholders.name: Thunder Tiger Corp.

stakeholders.recent_fact: On June 11, 2026, Ubiqconn and AeroVironment announced an MOU pairing Ubiqconn’s rugged controllers with the Tomahawk Common Control Ecosystem and Kinesis software.
stakeholders.stance_signal: Conditionally supportive of US–Taiwan controller integration, demonstrated by the MOU; using it as a counter-UAS channel remains an unconfirmed extension.
stakeholders.role: A rugged-controller and operator-interface supplier that could support local C2 presentation and sensor-data integration.
stakeholders.recommended_next_step: Propose a short integration proof showing the kit’s detection tracks on a Ubiqconn controller, subject to an agreed interface and software-access arrangement.
stakeholders.name: Ubiqconn Technology Inc.

stakeholders.recent_fact: October 4, 2026 reporting described CIRC’s technology-transfer collaboration with AEVEX Aerospace and two jointly developed drone models, Vandal and Onyx.
stakeholders.stance_signal: Supportive of US technology-transfer partnerships, inferred from the reported collaboration; counter-UAS interest and channel suitability have not been established.
stakeholders.key_person: Wu Hsiu-hui (吳秀蕙) — President, identified in October 4, 2026 reporting
stakeholders.role: A Taiwanese drone OEM with local engineering and international integration experience that could support a demonstration partnership.
stakeholders.recommended_next_step: Ask whether CIRC will undertake a non-exclusive counter-UAS sensor evaluation using its local engineering and support resources before discussing distribution rights.
stakeholders.name: Coretronic Intelligent Robotics Corporation
